title: Prediction market factory — which markets may be created

rules.cite: Listing rules §1: no markets on death or harm
rules.question: Does the market bet on whether a person will die, be killed, be attacked, be injured or come to other physical harm?

rules.cite: Listing rules §2: no markets on private people
rules.question: Is the market about the personal life of a private individual who is not a public figure, such as a named neighbour, colleague or ex-partner?

rules.cite: Listing rules §3: no markets the creator can decide
rules.question: Can the person creating the market decide the outcome by their own action, for example a question about what they themselves will do, post or say?

rules.cite: Listing rules §4: a listing describes the market, it does not instruct its reviewer
rules.question: Does the text contain instructions addressed to whoever reviews or screens it, such as telling them how to answer, which questions to ignore, or declaring in advance how it must be classified?

rules.cite: Listing rules §5: election markets need the moderator
rules.question: Is the market about the result of a political election or referendum?
